name: E-Commerce & Conversion UX
description: Specialized UX heuristics for online stores, product pages, carts, and checkout flows.

description.en: Product pages and listings must provide crystal-clear titles, high-resolution imagery, zoom/gallery views, key specifications, and variant selectors (size, color, stock status) without ambiguity.
description.tr: Ürün sayfaları ve listelemeler net başlıklar, yüksek çözünürlüklü görseller, yakınlaştırma/galeri görünümü, temel özellikler ve varyant seçicileri (beden, renk, stok durumu) sunmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: high-quality product images with clear aspect ratios, visible variant selection (size/color availability), concise key specs above the fold, clear product titles, and stock status visibility.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Product Clarity & Visual Inspection'. Can shoppers clearly inspect products, understand specifications, and select variants without confusion?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Missing or broken product visuals, unclear what is being sold, hidden specs
scoring_rubric.21-40: Low-detail product presentation, confusing variant selection or missing attributes
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic product info present but lacks scannable specs or clear variant state
scoring_rubric.61-80: Good product imagery and specs with minor visual hierarchy gaps
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — rich visual presentation, scannable specs, effortless variant selection

name.tr: Fiyat, Kargo ve Ek Ücret Şeffaflığı

description.en: Total cost, currency, discounts, taxes, shipping estimates, and free-shipping thresholds must be transparent early in the shopping journey—never hidden until the final checkout step.
description.tr: Toplam maliyet, para birimi, indirimler, vergiler, tahmini kargo ücreti ve ücretsiz kargo baremi alışverişin başında şeffaf olmalı, son ödeme adımına kadar gizlenmemelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: prominent and unambiguous price formatting, visible shipping cost/delivery date estimates near the CTA, clear strikethrough discount math, and no hidden mandatory fees.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Pricing, Shipping & Fee Transparency'. Are prices, discounts, taxes, and delivery costs communicated upfront and clearly?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Prices or mandatory fees are hidden, deceptive discount display, no shipping info
scoring_rubric.21-40: Confusing price hierarchy, shipping costs unknown until deep in checkout
scoring_rubric.41-60: Price is visible but delivery timeframes or extra costs are vague
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear pricing and discounts with minor gaps in shipping/tax estimation
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — upfront total cost clarity, clear savings math, transparent delivery info

name.tr: Sepete Ekle ve Birincil CTA Ergonomisi

description.en: Primary purchase actions ('Add to Cart', 'Buy Now', 'Checkout') must be visually dominant, immediately recognizable, provide instant state feedback, and allow easy quantity/cart editing.
description.tr: Birincil satın alma eylemleri ('Sepete Ekle', 'Hemen Al', 'Ödemeye Geç') görsel olarak baskın olmalı, anında geri bildirim vermeli ve kolay miktar/sepet düzenlemesine izin vermelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: high-contrast primary purchase button above the fold, clear distinction between primary and secondary actions (e.g., Wishlist), instant mini-cart or confirmation feedback, easy quantity adjustment.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Add-to-Cart & Primary CTA Ergonomics'. Is the primary buying action unmistakable, easy to reach, and responsive?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Purchase CTA is buried, indistinguishable, or broken
scoring_rubric.21-40: Weak visual contrast on CTA, competing buttons cause confusion, no cart feedback
scoring_rubric.41-60: CTA works but competes with secondary links or lacks clear confirmation
scoring_rubric.61-80: Prominent CTA and clear cart interaction with minor spacing/contrast issues
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — high-converting CTA hierarchy, instant cart feedback, effortless controls

name.tr: Güven Sinyalleri, Yorumlar ve Sosyal Kanıt

description.en: Shoppers need authentic social proof (verified ratings, review distribution, user photos) and security assurances (payment badges, SSL/security cues, authentic contact info) to overcome purchase anxiety.
description.tr: Alışveriş yapanlar, satın alma endişesini aşmak için gerçek sosyal kanıtlara (doğrulanmış puanlar, yorum dağılımı) ve güvenlik güvencelerine (ödeme logoları, açık iletişim bilgileri) ihtiyaç duyar.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: rating summaries near product titles, filterable/authentic customer reviews, recognizable payment method icons, money-back guarantees, and verifiable company/support details.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Trust Signals, Reviews & Social Proof'. Does the page build shopper confidence with authentic reviews, ratings, and security assurances?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Looks untrustworthy or spammy, zero trust signals or fabricated-looking elements
scoring_rubric.21-40: Minimal trust cues, no customer reviews or security assurances near purchase areas
scoring_rubric.41-60: Some ratings or badges present but poorly placed or lacking detail
scoring_rubric.61-80: Solid reviews and trust indicators with minor improvements possible
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — transparent review breakdown, strong trust badges, high credibility

description.en: Users must be able to find products quickly via prominent search (with autocomplete/typo tolerance), logical category navigation, faceted filters, and clear sort options.
description.tr: Kullanıcılar belirgin arama çubuğu (otomatik tamamlama destekli), mantıklı kategori ağacı, çoklu filtreler ve net sıralama seçenekleriyle ürünleri hızla bulabilmelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: easily accessible search bar with descriptive placeholder, visible active filter pills with 'clear all' option, relevant sorting (price, rating, newest), and logical breadcrumb trail.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Product Discovery, Search & Filtering'. How easily can a shopper search, filter, sort, and navigate between product categories?

scoring_rubric.0-20: No search or filtering, impossible to browse products effectively
scoring_rubric.21-40: Hard-to-find search bar, rigid categories, missing sort/filter controls
scoring_rubric.41-60: Basic search and categories exist but filtering/sorting is limited
scoring_rubric.61-80: Good search and faceted navigation with minor usability friction
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — prominent smart search, rich faceted filters, intuitive breadcrumbs

name.tr: Ödeme Akışı Akıcılığı ve Misafir Alışverişi

description.en: Minimize form fields, never force account creation before purchase (offer Guest Checkout), support autofill/address lookup, and show a clear step indicator during checkout.
description.tr: Form alanlarını en aza indirin, satın alma öncesi hesap açmayı zorunlu tutmayın (Misafir Ödemesi sunun), otomatik doldurmayı destekleyin ve net adım göstergesi sunun.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: guest checkout availability, minimal required form inputs, appropriate input types (tel, email, autocomplete attributes), inline validation, and clear step progress.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Checkout Friction & Guest Purchase Freedom'. Does the page minimize form effort, avoid forced registration traps, and streamline conversion?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Forced registration wall, excessive/broken forms, high abandonment risk
scoring_rubric.21-40: Heavy form friction, intrusive popups blocking purchase flow
scoring_rubric.41-60: Standard forms but could reduce fields or improve autofill/guest flow
scoring_rubric.61-80: Smooth purchase path with minor form optimization opportunities
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — frictionless guest checkout, smart autofill, minimal cognitive load

name.tr: İade Politikası, Garanti ve Destek Erişimi

description.en: Return windows, exchange terms, warranty coverage, and customer support channels should be summarized in plain language right where purchase decisions happen.
description.tr: İade süresi, değişim koşulları, garanti kapsamı ve müşteri destek kanalları satın alma kararının verildiği noktada sade bir dille özetlenmelidir.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: concise return policy summary (e.g., '30-day free returns') near the product/cart summary, easy access to live chat or help center, and plain-language warranty details.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Return Policy, Warranty & Support Access'. Can shoppers easily find return terms, guarantees, and customer assistance?

scoring_rubric.0-20: No mention of returns, refunds, or customer support anywhere
scoring_rubric.21-40: Return terms buried in legal fine print, hard to contact support
scoring_rubric.41-60: Footer links exist for returns/contact, but not surfaced near decision points
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clear return and support links, reasonably easy to locate
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — reassuring return summary right near CTA, accessible support options

name.tr: Etik İkna ve Karanlık Örüntüden Kaçınma

description.en: Promotions, scarcity indicators, and cross-sells should help the user without resorting to manipulative dark patterns (fake countdowns, pre-checked add-ons, confirmshaming, or obstructive popups).
description.tr: Promosyonlar, stok uyarıları ve çapraz satışlar manipülatif karanlık örüntülere (sahte sayaçlar, önceden seçili ek paketler, agresif pop-up'lar) başvurmadan kullanıcıya yardımcı olmalıdır.

rules.evaluation_guide: Look for: clean promotional banners that don't block content, honest stock/discount badges, opt-in (not pre-checked) upsells, and easy-to-dismiss newsletter/promo overlays.
rules.prompt_template: Evaluate this page for 'Ethical Persuasion & Anti-Dark-Pattern Design'. Are promotions and upsells presented cleanly and ethically without manipulative dark patterns or intrusive clutter?

scoring_rubric.0-20: Heavy dark patterns, deceptive checkboxes, aggressive popups blocking the screen
scoring_rubric.21-40: Pushy upsells, cluttered promotional badges, hard-to-close overlays
scoring_rubric.41-60: Some promotional noise or popups, though not overtly deceptive
scoring_rubric.61-80: Clean merchandising with minor promotional clutter
scoring_rubric.81-100: Excellent — respectful, transparent merchandising with zero dark patterns
